messages:
Maya: Quick: need a compact benchmark playbook for next Thurs webinar  focus = latency vs token spend. Deliverables: one-pager + 3 visuals + 2 social variants + inbound routing. Who owns?
Jon: Ill run data and produce CSVs. Visuals: 1) latency waterfall (P50/P95) by variant; 2) tokens->dollars Sankey with batching/cache savings; 3) small regional map with median latency and $/k tokens.
Priya: Messaging: no "fastest" claim. Lead line: \"Predictable inference economics for production teams.\" Use "up to" ranges and tie stats to workload type.
Tess: Ill mock the slide and social crops. Palette: teal + slate + orange accents. Horizontal 3-panel so it doubles as a slide + card.
Maya: Routing: SMB -> trial; Mid-market -> webinar + playbook; Enterprise -> demo + privacy brief. UTMs: utm_campaign=latency_spend_playbook&utm_segment={seg}. Route Enterprise leads to AE if intent_score > 70.
Jon: Will drop CSVs + query snippets by EOD and add methodology notes for appendix.
Priya: Two social variants: product (short) and ROI (longer). 20-word reg blurb: \"Benchmarks and tactics to reduce inference spend while preserving latency SLOs  real workloads, routing, and playbook.\"
Maya: Timeline: Jon data today, Tess mocks tomorrow, Priya copy tomorrow EOD, assemble one-pager Friday. Owners: Jon=data, Tess=visuals, Priya=copy. Thanks :rocket:
